commandPalette.title: Command palette
commandPalette.desc: Press Ctrl+K (⌘K on Mac) to search and run actions, tabs, samplers, checkpoints, LoRAs, presets, history and WebUI settings

history.title: Generation history
history.desc: Keep every txt2img and img2img result with its parameters and a thumbnail, stored in the extension's lobe_data folder

presets.title: Parameter presets
presets.desc: A Presets panel in the left sidebar to save and apply sampler, steps, CFG, size and hires fix settings

loraTools.title: LoRA card tools
loraTools.desc: Favorites, a weight per LoRA, model family badges, trigger words and filters on LoRA cards

tabProgress.title: Progress on tab icon
tabProgress.desc: A progress ring on the tab icon while generating, and a check mark when a background tab finishes

notification.title: Desktop notification
notification.desc: Notify when a generation finishes while the page is in the background (the browser asks for permission)

localAssets.title: Local assets
localAssets.desc: Load the logo, icons and fonts from the extension instead of a CDN, so the theme works without internet access

imageButtonsTop.title: Image buttons under Generate
imageButtonsTop.desc: Moves the image buttons (open folder, save, zip, send to img2img, inpaint, extras...) from under the gallery to right under Generate / Interrupt / Skip

sizeTools.title: Aspect ratios and suggested settings
sizeTools.desc: Under Width and Height: aspect ratios at a base size that follows the model, a ratio lock, and steps / CFG scale suited to the loaded model

chaoticSeeds.title: Chaotic seeds
chaoticSeeds.desc: Under Seed: each Generate can roll a seed with a random number of digits (4 to 15 by default) instead of -1, so seeds jump across magnitudes

cornerStyle.desc: Corners of buttons, fields, panels and cards
cornerStyle.title: Corners

density.desc: Compact tightens tabs, accordions, fields and spacing so more fits on screen
density.title: Density

surfaceStyle.desc: Flat: plain panels. Glass: frosted, translucent header and sidebars. Elevated: cards with soft shadows
surfaceStyle.title: Surfaces

fontFamily.desc: Interface font. All are bundled, so they work offline; Be Vietnam Pro is drawn for Vietnamese
fontFamily.title: Font

sidebarSwap.desc: Quick Setting on the right, Extra Network on the left
sidebarSwap.title: Swap sidebars

accordionMode.desc: One at a time: opening an accordion folds the others next to it. Folding never switches an extension off
accordionMode.title: Accordions

systemMonitor.title: Resource monitor
systemMonitor.desc: RAM, VRAM and GPU load while the panel is visible

memoryKeeper.title: Memory keeper
memoryKeeper.desc: Under System: what holds the VRAM and the RAM, and buttons to free it, all of it or one thing at a time, except what you keep

progressBarStyle.desc: Aurora: a flowing gradient with a glowing head, and step, percent and ETA on the bar
progressBarStyle.title: Progress bar

resultFrameStyle.desc: Animated frame around the result while an image is made. Glow edge: a turning coloured edge. Pulse: a ring at every step. Ambient: the preview's own colours glow behind it. Scan: a line sweeps down. Orbit: lights circle the frame
resultFrameStyle.title: Result frame

promptSections.title: Prompt sections
promptSections.desc: A button under the prompt splits the positive prompt into sections joined with BREAK; the prompt that is generated and saved still reads with BREAK

layoutPreset.title: Layout preset
layoutPreset.desc: Where the blocks go. Only the layout changes: colours, fonts and every other setting stay as they are

classic.title: Classic
classic.desc: Tabs across the top, the prompt above the settings and the result

studio.title: Studio
studio.desc: Tabs in a rail on the left; controls and result side by side, each as tall as the window

studioMirror.title: Studio, mirrored
studioMirror.desc: Like Studio, with the result on the left and the controls on the right

appearanceMode.title: Color mode
appearanceMode.desc: Saved with your accent and neutral colors, including when opening a fresh URL.

workbench.title: Prompt Workbench
workbench.desc: Enable the compact Prompt Workbench bar (quick tools and collapsible panels).

hideTipoPrompt.title: Hide TIPO prompt & button
hideTipoPrompt.desc: Hide TIPO Tag/NL prompt fields and the Generate Prompt button in the prompt area.

system.noNvml: GPU load and temperature need nvidia-ml-py
system.noNvmlHint: Restart the WebUI once so the theme can install nvidia-ml-py, or run: pip install nvidia-ml-py
system.title: System

memory.title: Memory
memory.freeRamTip: Let go of what is only in RAM (models moved off the GPU, caches, servers on the CPU), but what is kept (🔒); what is on the GPU stays
memory.freeVramTip: Everything off the GPU but what is kept (🔒): models go to RAM, LLM servers are stopped
memory.freeAllTip: VRAM and RAM: Let go of everything but what is kept (🔒); the checkpoint loads again on the next generation
memory.toRamTip: Off the GPU, kept in RAM: back fast when used
memory.unloadTip: Out of the GPU and out of RAM
memory.reloadOnNextGeneration: After unloading, the next generation loads the model again
memory.keep: Keep it: Free VRAM and Free VRAM + RAM leave it alone
memory.unkeep: Kept: Free VRAM and Free VRAM + RAM leave it alone. Click to stop keeping it
memory.sectionFreeTip: Let go of everything in this section but what is kept (🔒)
memory.nothing: Nothing loaded: no checkpoint, no models, no caches.
memory.modeTip: The memory manager's VRAM mode, changed without a restart; a restart goes back to the mode the WebUI started in.
memory.modeSet: VRAM mode: {{mode}}; models are placed again by the next generation

modeTips.high: High: models stay on the GPU, nothing is moved back to RAM
modeTips.normal: Normal: models on the GPU as far as they fit, the text encoder on the GPU
modeTips.low: Low: models on the GPU as far as they fit, the text encoder in RAM

memory.modeStartup: the WebUI started in this mode
memory.generationBusy: Generation is in progress. Try again when it finishes.

holderDetails.checkpoint: Unloaded. The next generation loads it again.
holderDetails.gpuModel: On the GPU. The model file stays cached in RAM.
holderDetails.cache:lora: Read from disk again when used.
holderDetails.cache:clipvision: Preprocessor models. Loaded again when used.
holderDetails.faceModel: Face restoration. Loaded again when used.
holderDetails.seedvr2: Cached in RAM between images. Read from disk again after unloading.

queue.title: Queue
queue.settingsDescription: Control what happens when the queue finishes and manage waiting jobs. Queue changes take effect immediately.
queue.presetFilterHint: Only models matching the active UI preset ({{preset}}) are enabled

palette.savePreset: Save current parameters as a preset

workspace.description: Arrange panels and tools for each generation tab. Drag the handles or use the arrow buttons. Changes take effect after Apply.
workspace.presetClassicDesc: Standard WebUI without SplitView: 2-zone Stage on top, parameters & gallery below.
workspace.presetInferenceDesc: SplitView enabled: 3 columns (Params | Prompt | Preview) or 2-column Cockpit.
workspace.presetStudioDesc: Centered preview & prompt (Variant A); parameters toggle open on the left.
workspace.empty: No configurable items in this area.
workspace.scriptNote: Hiding an item only changes its visibility. Script and its controls stay in Forge’s original layout.
